reviews.title: Scammers
reviews.text: A few months ago, I tried to purchase an audiobook through this app. I made the payment using Apple Pay, but afterwards, I couldn’t log into my account because the app didn’t recognise my email address or any of the details linked to my Apple Pay. I contacted customer service by email but never received a response. Four months later, I’m still being charged for a subscription I can’t even access. Be very careful with this app. Once they have your payment details, they continue taking your money, and customer service is nowhere to be found when you need help. In my experience, this feels like a scam. They are happy to take your money but offer absolutely no support when something goes wrong. Extremely disappointing and unacceptable

reviews.title: Audiobooks new user experience
reviews.text:
I’ve taken a free trial for the app but a few early experiences mean I won’t take it further. The VIP options available were poor and the choices I made disappeared immediately, taking days to reappear.

The app does not synchronise well with my in car system, not displaying the book title screen and so making control of the app via the car system really difficult- this is the main way I use audio books so a problem for me. The app has today stopped working and is refusing to load

The first book I listened to was really good quality in narration and sound, but on the second (a VIP selection) it was the opposite- dull narration without feeling and audio quality which cycled constantly between loud and quiet

reviews.title: Terrible scam
reviews.text: Signed up for a free trial, which they immediately charged me for - then tried to cancel and get reimbursed, however the website and app are so scammy they make it impossible to cancel, even giving me error messages in Spanish. I also couldn’t use the live chat function as it was closed, and it said it opens at 1pm - came back at 1pm only to have an terrible AI telling me to do the same steps I’d already taken, so I asked for a human, to which they said all their live agents are unavailable until Monday 9am EST, I asked again and it said I could speak to them at 9am EST (1pm GMT - which is NOW) and it didn’t specify a day, so which is it? Available now, or do o have to wait 6 days, conveniently until after the “free trial” ends before I can speak to someone??? I want my money back that was taken without my consent, and I want nothing more to do with this useless company.
